display_name: Phase2 MoPC 原 B 状态确定性双次支持诊断（GPU7）
description: 同一实际保存 B 和原支持集在确定性 CUDA 设置下执行两次诊断，比较状态和故障；仅诊断，不产生预测。

data.representation: eq1 first256 float64 raw -> original FP32 unit-RMS -> fixed practical residual/post_sync/no additional EQ

permissions.regime: source-only checkpoint and labeled L_s plus exactly the current B/C supports
permissions.external_method_exception: ProtoNet B uses current labeled old-class support only.
permissions.claim_scope: Deterministic-kernel diagnostic on original GPU7 only; not equivalent to original settings by assumption; no query, truth, prediction or score.

checkpoint.initialization: Exact actual r11 per-K saved B anchor for c0192; no B refit
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: r11 actual saved B bound to original job, K, old split, seed; source smoke first.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Original r13 failed task, no target scoring or selection.

rows.seed_notes: Fixed existing capsule. B/C seeds derive from original model seed and job key. No new data, augmentation or evaluation draws.
rows.optimizer: Saved B anchor; original MoPC SGD momentum .9, weight decay .0002

notes: Two repetitions use the exact r11 B anchor, original support and C seed under deterministic CUDA.
Determinisitic CUDA is a diagnostic intervention, not a production change or proof of identical results.
No query, truth, predictions or scoring; prior outputs remain untouched.
